newsitem.title: USA: Fed doesn't intervene during usual time on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Fed doesn't intervene during usual time on Friday.

text.p: The Federal Reserve, as expected, stayed out of the banking system during its usual intervention period Friday morning.
Economists said that with 10- and five-day system repurchase agreements on the books, the Fed's add need had been met until at least Monday.
The federal funds rate was trading at 5-3/16 percent, near the Fed's current official target level of 5.25 percent.
-- John P. Hughes, N.A. Treasury Desk, 212-859-1663
